challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: The current manual intervention in serving creates a bottleneck that directly delays our promotion readiness. We need the model serving process to run automatically without human steps in the loop. Every hour spent on manual checks is an hour where we are not optimizing for the middle aisle traffic. The goal is to remove all manual handling from the serving pipeline. This will allow us to react instantly to demand shifts during the promotion week. The more automated the serving becomes, the faster we can secure availability and reduce the risk of stockouts on advertised items. This is a clear priority for the next quarter.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly states that the more automated the serving becomes, the faster the team can secure availability and reduce stockout risk, indicating that exceeding the baseline of simply removing manual steps to achieve higher automation levels would make the author happier.
